snippet.title: Inertial Drift | Out Now on PS4, Nintendo Switch & Steam. Coming soon to Xbox One
snippet.description:
Forget everything you know about drifting. Inertial Drift tears up the racing rule book with innovative twin-stick controls, completely re-imagined driving mechanics and a roster of fiercely individual cars.

Find out more:
http://pqube.co.uk/inertial-drift
Try "Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue" for FREE:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302110/Inertial_Drift_Sunset_Prologue/ 
Wishlist the full game on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/Inertial_Drift/
